Your journey to pain relief starts here at Aloha Wellness Center Inc. in Oahu, Hawai‘i. Call/text (808) 723-2921 to schedule an appointment today. 

Our services include:
✨ Physical Therapy
✨ Medical Massage
✨ Shockwave Therapy
✨ Acupuncture 
✨ Pain Management and Rehabilitation 

We warmly welcome veterans, accept VA authorized referrals, and other medical insurance plans.
📍 Aiea, Hawai‘i
📞 Call/text 808-723-2921 to schedule an appointment.
